answer: The garden counter is kept in opal and trellis exposes each reset. An farming party therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 12 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 12 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1589 identities would post 2494 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
